title: What Makes a Contract Binding?
paragraphs: A contract is a promise between people. The law can make people keep this promise. You make contracts every day. You buy a bus ticket. You rent a flat.
A contract needs an offer. One person says, “I will sell you my bike for 50 pounds.” The other person must say yes. This is acceptance.
Both people must give something. The seller gives a bike. The buyer gives money. Both people must also be adults and understand the deal.
Sometimes one person breaks the promise. Then a judge can help. Often the judge asks that person to pay money. A small contract can be spoken. A big one is better on paper.

questions.a: A promise between people that the law can enforce.
